title: 床置きボール盤
description: 街の整備工房やメーカースペースに置く床置きボール盤。取付穴付き鋳物ベース、丸支柱、調整用カラーとクランク、実際に抜けたスロットと中心穴を持つ作業台、ベルトカバー、後部モーター外装、クイルと空のチャック、三本の送りハンドル、正面スイッチを備えます。ドリル刃、材料、加工動作は含みません。電気・機械・荷重支持・安全性は未検証の静的な外観モデルで、操作・製作の指示は付属しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.490 × 1.635 × 0.809 m、12,034三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A floor-standing drill press for municipal maintenance workshops and makerspaces, with an apertured cast base, round column, adjustable-table collar and crank, genuine table slots and central clearance hole, closed belt cover, rear motor exterior, quill and empty chuck, three-spoke feed handle and front switches. No drill bit, stock or cutting action is included. Static appearance geometry with no electrical, mechanical, load-bearing or safety validation and no operation or fabrication instructions. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.490 × 1.635 × 0.809 m; 12,034 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
